General/Wizard Alchemy.title: Wizard Alchemy Script Update
General/Wizard Alchemy.description:
[+] Added:

> • Added Venom Spider Lair (World 4) — 7 new spider monsters in a separate Monster World selection (Man-Eating Spider, Frenzied Spider, Deadly Man-Eating Spider, Deadly Cannibal Spider, Cannibal Spider, Plague Spider, Spider Queen).
> • Added Pirate Hideout (World 3) — pirates are now their own Monster World selection, separate from Sea of Oblivion.
> • Added Spider Queen to Boss Health Bar detection.
> • Added Spider Queen to Auto Boss Farm with World 4 teleport. (Premium)
> • Added 3 new materials to Auto Sell & Auto Gather: Spider Egg, Crystal Orchid Grove, Large Crystal Orchid Grove.
> • Added World 4 NPC support to Auto Sell — Lambert is now detected in Venom Spider Lair.
> • Added Tide Drifter and Venom Spider Kin to Auto Race Roll. (Premium)
> • Added 4 new Equipment Shop buy toggles: Spider Venom Wand Legendary, Venomous Master Legendary Hat, Venomous Master Legendary Clothe, Poison Spider Broom.
> • Added 2 new Location Teleport buttons: Venom Spider Lair, Spider Queen Boss.
> • Added Venom Spider Lair (4) to the World Teleport dropdown.
> • Added Auto Quest: Venom Spider Lair — 5 quests (Web-Weaving Assassin I & II, Venomous Shadow I & II, Queen's Wraith). (Premium)

[*] Fixed:

> • Fixed Spider Queen boss not teleporting to its position — World 4 was not being detected by the world check.  (Premium)
> • Fixed Farm Position, Farm Distance, and Auto Skill Slots not restoring correctly from saved config.
